name: Bookish & Library
tagline: Reading nooks, grand libraries and dark-academia moods.
description: For readers, writers and dark-academia lovers: grand old libraries with rolling ladders, antique bookshops, candlelit studies, rainy window seats, park-bench paperbacks, book clubs and green banker's lamps. Warm, literary and quietly photogenic.
